name: webapp-testing
tagline_zh: 本地网页上线前，用 Playwright 自动点、查、截图、翻日志。像有个 QA 在浏览器里替你踩坑。
tagline_en: Test local web apps with Playwright: click, verify, screenshot, and pull logs. Your built-in QA that catches UI.
desc_en: Toolkit for interacting with and testing local web applications using Playwright. Supports verifying frontend functionality, debugging UI behavior, capturing browser screenshots, and viewing browser logs.
why_zh: 同类工具只测功能，它连浏览器日志和截图一起给，调试不用来回切窗口，一步到位。
why_en: Unlike plain test runners, it bundles screenshots and browser logs into one flow, so debugging never leaves the context.
